title: Chapel ruin stonework
summary: The subject is known exactly and named by its maker, but no stable subject identifier exists for it. The literal identity alone carries the subject, offline and with no registry.

target.description: Ruined chapel wall section, MDF kit assembled with the buttress on

identity.qualifier: assembled with the optional buttress, which changes which faces are reachable

steps.title: Stone base
steps.instruction: Basecoat every stone face with Cold Stone, working the brush into the mortar lines.

steps.title: Moss in the shelter
steps.instruction: Stipple Damp Moss only where the buttress shelters the wall; leave the exposed faces bare.
